36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
215499: A boy in the Houjou clan who was expected to inherit the rule of the Kamakura shogunate. He excels at fleeing and is now gathering strength at Suwa Grand Shrine so he can use that skill in his efforts to reclaim the throne.
300898: Worshiped as the God of Suwa by having the spirit of Suwa Myojin within him. He's the person who offers safety to Tokiyuki after the fall of his clan in 1333. He is one of the 3 most outstanding arahitogami in Japan.
300902: The priestess of Suwa Shrine under the orders of Yorishige. She's a member of Elusive Warriors.
300903: The man who overthrew the Kamakura shogunate with his overwhelming strength and charisma, causing Tokiyuki's family and standing to be lost.
300904: Tokiyuki's ally and a member of Elusive Warriors. He belongs to the Nezu clan.
300906: A thief that belongs to the Kazama clan, a branch of the Suwa clan. He is a member of the Elusive Warriors.
320996: A strategist and swordsman who travels in search of a lord. Initially was a member of the Elusive Warriors.
339810: Eldest son of Takatoki Hojou and the older half-brother of Tokiyuki.
339815: Vassal of the shogunate who commits suicide after the fall of Kamakura Shogunate. Father of Kiyoko Settsu.
339818: Weapons Master of the Kamakura Shogunate.
340793: Retainer of the Kamakura Shogunate and uncle of Kunitoki and Tokiyuki.
341164: Member of the Suwa Clan and the commentator of the Suwa Shrine.
349870: Shogun of Kyoto. He is the son of the Emperor.
349878: Sadamune's assistant. He serves as the Shugo of Shinano.
350262: Emperor of Japan following the fall of the Kamakura Shogunate.
350274: Bandit leader and subordinate of Sadmune.
